project_claims.simulation: Ten persons, 40 simulated minutes on the scratch harness. REPL checks reported for the duplicate requirement; numeric and Proposal symptoms reported without isolated failing fixtures.

source_inspection.programs/sglp/cva/harness.glp.in.md#1: Canonical agents/3 calls agent/5. The two pinned platforms export agent/6 and read the environment at startup. Scratch harness supplies environment by key and leaves the canonical harness unchanged.
source_inspection.programs/sglp/cva/harness.glp.in.md#2: The canonical monitor's start_clock/step_clock and machine now/1 are separate. The two baseline artifacts have no dated/2. PR 146 emits it and the scratch monitor bridges the two clocks; clock views are supplied in the scratch harness. Scope the finding to date-enabled contracts without a bridge.
source_inspection.programs/vglp/cva/compiler/cvac.glp.md#1: text.glp rs_req appends kept and ordinary deleted requirements; cand_ok applies multiset subtraction. The duplicate fails with a single occurrence. On PR 146, rank_behind uses the ordinary deletion without repeating the bid in its kept requirements.
source_inspection.programs/vglp/cva/compiler/cvac.glp.md#2: eq_ext can solve for one free variable on either side given a solvable integer equality. Candidate adds Score and Late atoms, so it does not isolate the reported failures. Ask for original schema, request and state plus a control.
source_inspection.programs/vglp/cva/compiler/cvac.glp.md#3: cvac.glp uses local.glp proposable; guarded schemas need a canonical binding that determines a transaction. Per-participant delete/add overlap fails deltas_valid. Clarify intended semantics versus a missing diagnostic and attach exact source and output.
